stages.name: one-row
stages.claim: How to read a bar: the share of the held-out log likelihood ratio over the random-walk null, left to right as capabilities switch on; the total is the per-transition likelihood multiplier.

stages.name: baseline
stages.claim: The classical model, influence plus kernel shape, alone: its share runs from 0.6% on VKontakte to 98% on SPINOS.

stages.name: tail
stages.claim: The heavy tail (Laplace over Gaussian) adds on 13 of 15 panels, and is the largest segment on 9.

stages.name: retention
stages.claim: Latent retention adds on 13 of 15 panels; it is 63% of the gain on CMV and 42% on VKontakte.

stages.name: selection
stages.claim: Neighbour selection adds on 6 of 8 networked panels. The totals: CMV 6.26x, VKontakte 2.90x, ADAMS-high 2.03x, SPINOS 1.08x.

stages.name: pictograms
stages.claim: Each pictogram is the fitted kernel at that step: flat dotted is DeGroot, solid is RFF. Shapes bend as mechanisms switch on.
